text: diantara
bou.house

In big city like Jakarta, most of the house is located in small alley that usually only has access for one car, motorcycle, bicycle and pedestrians. Diantara house is one of our exercises to create problem solving design. We hope that Diantara house’s design can work as an example for those who have rent houses in small alley, couples with no child, salaryman who lives alone, maybe students who want it bigger than a studio room, cyclist and those who prefer commute with public transportation.

Diantara house is a loft type tiny house, with one bedroom and balcony on the second level. As Diantara is made to be located in an alley, the roofless facade is good to let natural lighting in. And also minimizing the damage to alley’s road because of water dripping from the roof and make the alley brighter and have better air circulation

In big city like Jakarta, we often see many people live in small houses forced to bring their motorcycle into their house for safety, but in Diantara we provide small garage for them so it wont disturb activities inside and jeoperdize resident’s health.
temu
bou.house

An exploratory study of a micro housing project on an area of ​​8x4 meters, with the theme of new normal living and the concept of space saving that uses a space function transformation approach or creating multifunctional space and furniture. Raising the issue of social distancing which requires a small family to do more productive activities and socialize from home.
The pandemic has made many of us have to adapt to new ways of life, one of which is contactless. Temu house is responding to this new culture by designing transformable spaces.

Apart from being able to receive guests without having to invite them in, this area can also be used as a place of business such as grocery shop or as simple as a favorite place to read books and relax.
koru
bou.house

The concept of a SoHo house (small office home office), a retail shop with a small land size (4x8 meters) as the solution for micro business players who open their retail on the side road and on densely populated residential areas

For Koru House, we are using real issue on the field spesifically retails at Dipatiukur street, Bandung. By creating this concept, we hope in the future all the retails there can be made into a standardized visual so the area will look cleaner and tidier
Divide the mass of the building vertically into 2 parts, a private area for the owner's residence and semipublic areas for garages, offices, culinary business, goods / service business, etc.

The 1st floor area has an effective area of ​​16 m2 which can be used as a place of business. There is a boundary area of ​​1.5 m wide building for the parking area and there is enough distance to provide privacy in indoor activities
The living area (private) needs to be facilitated completely starting from the resting and relaxing area, as well as areas for cooking and eating
selebu
bou.house

Selebu in Indonesian language means wide or broad. Selebu type of house is already rarely seen especially in high density population area like Jakarta. But if you manage to have land that has wider dimension on its facade, maybe Selebu can be your refrence
Selebu house’s zoning and blocking for private (bedroom), service (bathroom and kitchen) and semi-public (living room) is well-organized without interfering each other.
The interior combines the functions of a living room and dining room for a narrow and elongated space solution

What is good about wider facade is you have a lot of things that can be shown better like details and some selling point elements of the house. And another important thing is all the rooms can have good openings so that natural lighting and air circulation can be well spreaded

Placing the bathroom as an outbuilding mass in the front view is one of the Selebu unique selling point and also using the front area of ​​the house that extends as a space to socialize and other outdoor activities
sabang
bou.coffee

Sabang Community Space was designed and proposed in association with tava studio circa 2019. Sabang is mainly a coffee shop, but it also provides rooms for rostery workshop, cupping, classroom and whole other process of coffee itself. Sabang was designed in hope that coffee business development in Indonesia is made by locals, from locals and for locals. The design is made modern and timeless, highlighting black as signature color of coffee and red brick as an accent to represents locality

ikat
bou.commercial

Ikat Wedding Venue was designed and proposed in association with tava studio circa 2019. Ikat accomodates outdoor and indoor wedding ceremony with one roomy-joglo-style indoor hall and three outdoor yards. The design is a combination of local and modern references, using pelana roofing on a minimalist open building, makes Ikat can be used by everyone no matter what their background is.
facts: Concept : Modern x local wedding venue

text: raindeer
bou.coffee

Raindeer coffee is a modern and simple coffee shop designed for small - medium space. A two stories coffee shop featured with many big windows to let natural lighting and air circulation in and well spreaded with cross ventilation.
Material used in Raindeer represents well of Jou and Bou principle design in color pattern and use of nature elements especially natural stones
Second floor is made into mezzanine so that the building still feel like one tall building. Light-colored solid wood material is used on the floor and ceiling to make the room brighter and spacious
